title: The Cone of Roasted Chickpeas
youtube_title: The Cone of Roasted Chickpeas | Bedtime Story for Kids in English
moral: Saving a turn for someone else keeps the joy whole.
summary: At a picnic cloth in a calm meadow, Eko sees that a paper cone of roasted chickpeas will not feel fair if only one person is served first. Eko makes a smaller, even share so Una is included, and the baker lets the choice stand without a speech.
